We have Sophia -> ... -> Madison -> ... -> Ralph. So Sophia is ancestor of Madison, which is ancestor of Ralph. So Sophia is ancestor of Ralph (through Madison). Christine is also ancestor of Ralph (through Amanda). So both Sophia and Christine are ancestors of Ralph. Therefore they share a common descendant (Ralph).
